Level 4 - Advanced 45 min Machine coding Time plan Driver & demo

Machine-Coding Round Guide: Time Plan, Driver & Demo

A minute-by-minute playbook for the 90-120 minute build-and-demo round used by Flipkart, PhonePe, Razorpay, Swiggy, Meesho, CRED and others: how to read the problem, split P0 from bonus, keep a runnable version at every checkpoint, write a driver that demos everything, survive the evaluation call, and handle the new AI-allowed and AI-banned variants.
